title: Tom Brady, 48, says he explored return to NFL but league ‘don’t like that idea very much’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tom Brady, 48, says he explored return to NFL but league ‘don’t like that idea very much’
sources.description: Tom Brady says he explored the idea of making a return to the NFL as a player but the league “don’t like that idea very much”. Brady’s last NFL game came in a defeat to the Dallas Cowboys in January 2023. Since then he has become a part-owner of the Las Vegas Raiders as well as a television analyst for Fox.
